notes: stream of 2000 manifests from 50 publishers (Zipf s = 1.1) under one root, each publisher with its own issuing CA
leaf lifecycles: one per publisher, a new one every 100 manifests, and a new one per manifest
LRU cache of validated certificates keyed on SHA-256; a cached leaf skips both path verifications, a cached issuing CA skips one
half-way through, the most frequent publisher's issuing CA is distrusted; snapshot-tagged caches drop entries validated under the old trust list, naive ones do not
total_ms is measured over the whole stream, including the manifest signature verification of every accepted manifest
merged from 10 independent runs (fresh processes and keys, random experiment and configuration order); median_ms is the median of per-run medians, ci95_ms a 95% bootstrap interval over runs
